units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:4">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> (play on <he>פ̇ח̇ז̇</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 49:4">Gen. XLIX, 4</cite>) <he>פ̇רקת עול ח̇ללת יְצוּעִי זֹע וכ׳</he> thou hast thrown off the yoke (restraint), thou hast desecrated my couch, thy passion within thee was agitated.

<cite ref="Shabbat 55b:8">Sabb. 55ᵇ</cite> (ref. to Gen. l. c.) <he>א״ת יְצוּעִי אלא יְצוּעַיי</he> (missing in Ms. M., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) read not ‘my couch’ but ‘my couches’.—Pl. <he>יְצוּעִים</he>, <he>יְצוּעִין</he>. Gen. R. l. c. <he>קלקל את הי׳</he> he disgraced his father’s couches.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 3:1">Tosef. B. Bath. III, 1</cite> <he>היְצִיעִין</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>היְצָעִים</he>); Y. ib. IV, 14ᶜ bot. <he>יְצוּ׳</he> the mattresses in the press (for the laborers or watchmen).
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 4:1">Tosef. ib. IV, 1</cite> <he>יְצִי׳</he>; Y. ib. V, beg. 15ᶜ <he>יְצוּ׳</he> the mattresses on board of ships.
